mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_segment (workspace_id, run_id, segment_no, attempt_no, reserved_steps, known_steps, turn_id, execution_generation, privacy_generation, organization_privacy_generation, reserved_tokens, known_input_tokens, known_output_tokens, usage_uncertain, status, failure_reason, provider_declaration_fingerprint, deadline_at, started_at, settled_at) VALUES (#{segment.workspaceId}, #{segment.runId}, #{segment.segmentNo}, #{segment.attemptNo}, #{segment.reservedSteps}, #{segment.knownSteps}, #{segment.turnId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{segment.executionGeneration}, #{segment.privacyGeneration}, #{segment.organizationPrivacyGeneration}, #{segment.reservedTokens}, #{segment.knownInputTokens}, #{segment.knownOutputTokens}, #{segment.usageUncertain}, #{segment.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{segment.failureReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{segment.providerDeclarationFingerprint,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{segment.deadlineAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{segment.startedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{segment.settledAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent_segment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT *, FROM ai_agent_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'queued' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND execution_deadline_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND hard_deadline_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND withheld_at IS NULL AND purged_at IS NULL ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.*, FROM ai_agent_run r WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.status = 'running' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_run_lease l WHERE l.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND l.subject_kind = 'agent_run' AND l.subject_id = r.id AND l.released_at IS NULL AND l.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_agent_run r LEFT JOIN ai_agent_segment a ON a.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND a.id = r.active_segment_id LEFT JOIN ai_chat_turn t ON t.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND t.id = a.turn_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.status = 'running' AND (a.id IS NULL OR a.run_id != r.id OR a.status != 'running' OR a.execution_generation != r.execution_generation OR t.id IS NULL OR t.status != 'running' OR t.mission_run_id IS NULL OR t.mission_segment_id IS NULL OR t.mission_run_id != r.id OR t.mission_segment_id != a.id OR t.session_id != r.session_id OR a.privacy_generation != r.privacy_generation OR t.privacy_generation IS NULL OR t.privacy_generation != r.privacy_generation)

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT workspace_id FROM ai_agent_run WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} ORDER BY workspace_id

SELECT *, FROM ai_agent_run WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND runtime_contract_version = 2 AND status = 'paused' AND reason_code = 'interrupted' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND execution_deadline_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND hard_deadline_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND withheld_at IS NULL AND purged_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_segment exhausted WHERE exhausted.workspace_id = ai_agent_run.workspace_id AND exhausted.run_id = ai_agent_run.id AND exhausted.segment_no = ai_agent_run.last_committed_segment_no + 1 AND exhausted.attempt_no >= 3 ) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_segment SET known_steps = known_steps + 1, usage_uncertain = TRUE WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND id = #{segmentId} AND execution_generation = #{generation} AND status = 'running' AND known_steps = #{expectedOrdinal} AND usage_uncertain = FALSE AND known_steps < reserved_steps AND #{tokenCeiling} > 0 AND #{tokenCeiling} <= reserved_tokens - known_input_tokens - known_output_tokens

UPDATE ai_agent_segment SET known_input_tokens = known_input_tokens + #{input}, known_output_tokens = known_output_tokens + #{output}, usage_uncertain = FALSE WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND id = #{segmentId} AND execution_generation = #{generation} AND status = 'running' AND known_steps = #{ordinal} AND usage_uncertain = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_tool_call (workspace_id, message_id, mission_run_id, artifact_origin, privacy_generation, organization_privacy_generation, tool_name, status, arguments_json, result_json, executed_by_user_id, executed_at, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{call.workspaceId}, #{call.messageId}, #{call.missionRunId}, 'mission', #{call.privacyGeneration}, #{call.organizationPrivacyGeneration}, #{call.toolName}, 'executed', CONVERT(#{call.argumentsJson,jdbcType=VARBINARY,typeHandler=ooo.klae.connex.backend.mappers.AiIdentifierUtf8TextTypeHandler} USING utf8mb4), CONVERT(#{call.resultJson,jdbcType=VARBINARY,typeHandler=ooo.klae.connex.backend.mappers.AiIdentifierUtf8TextTypeHandler} USING utf8mb4), #{call.executedByUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), #{call.idempotencyKey})
